scope: Internal emitted DXF record identity inventory supports 64-bit self and owner handles, with unchanged public 32-bit semantic handle API. Output paths with active inventory refuse wide self/owner identities until a 64-bit seed and graph policy are implemented.
validation: Focused real-workspace writer inventory CTest passes for ASCII and binary, 64-bit owners and self handles, rollback, leading-zero numeric duplicate detection, maximal uint64 inventory, destination-preserving wide-self and wide-owner refusals, and same-writer corrected retry.
Five fast writer and raw application/proxy CTests pass (5/5).
Isolated release shared-library build and install succeeds; SHA-256 da0f761cf5fb0a352dc28f1b878c23fce0f37ef167bc921afc5e704ae7a3c3f2.

LibreCAD system-codec HATCH/identity controls pass 53 assertions in 5 cases against that library; dyld confirms the loaded path. Named-linetype and property-sheet controls pass 109 assertions in 10 cases.
limitations: This does not enable wide-handle output, 64-bit semantic remapping or independent wide graph support.
The explicit full-file guard applies to paths with active emitted-record inventory; existing non-inventory behavior is not qualified by these tests.
Previously qualified platform and native evidence belongs to earlier source digests and does not transfer.
The first attempted inventory validation used a build directory from another checkout and is excluded.
